title: 3 AI Infra CEOs Expose What Nobody Says About AI Agents (Feat. Stytch, Arize AI, Letta Founders)
description:
The most brutally honest takes on AI agents you'll hear this year. Three industry insiders drop shocking truths about why most AI agent projects fail, the hidden barriers preventing adoption, and the controversial reality behind the "agent explosion." From MCP haters turned believers to the dark side of multi-agent systems, this conversation exposes what nobody talks about in public.

Featuring 3 Battle-Tested CEOs:
🔸 Reed McGinley-Stempel - Co-Founder & CEO at Stytch (Identity & Access Management for AI Agents)
🔸 Jason Lopatecki - Founder & CEO at Arize AI (AI Observability & Evaluation Leader)
🔸 Charles Packer - Co-Founder & CEO at Letta (Stateful AI Agents, formerly MemGPT creator)

These founders break down the technical and non-technical barriers preventing real AI agent adoption, share war stories from the trenches, and make bold predictions about the future of the space. No corporate BS, just raw truth from people building in the arena.

Key Moments:
1:47 - The single biggest catalyst behind the agent explosion (spoiler: it's not what you think)
6:51 - What "production-ready AI agents" actually means (most definitions are wrong)
11:44 - Why enterprise ROI conversations are killing AI projects
24:53 - The great MCP debate: hater to believer transformation
31:14 - The biggest gap in AI infrastructure that nobody's solving
